init.title: Update {device_name} firmware
init.description: The Everything Presence Pro Grid integration expects firmware **{required_version}** but **{device_name}** is running **{current_version}**. Click **Submit** to install the required firmware over the air now. The device will reboot once flashing completes — this usually takes about a minute. Some integration features may not work correctly until the firmware is updated.

error.ota_trigger_failed: Could not start the firmware update — the device may be offline, or its build flags may not be cached yet. Try again in a moment.

firmware_ahead.title: {device_name} integration update required
firmware_ahead.description: {device_name} is running firmware **{current_version}** but the Everything Presence Pro Grid integration is pinned to **{required_version}**. Update the integration via HACS so it can talk to the newer firmware. Some integration features may not work correctly until the integration is updated.
